explanations.cross_domain_form: The page's form sends entered data to an external, third-party domain instead of its own.
explanations.brand_mismatch: The page claims to be a well-known brand (e.g., Microsoft/Google) but is hosted on an unrelated domain.
explanations.raw_ip_or_odd_host: The website is hosted on a raw IP address or uses an atypical, suspicious domain host.
explanations.disguised_password_box: The page contains input fields disguised or styled to secretly capture credentials.
explanations.entry_vector_qr_email_redirect: You arrived via a direct email link, QR code scan, or multi-hop redirect chain.
explanations.clipboard_command_or_fake_oauth: The site attempted to inject executable shell commands to your clipboard or displayed a deceptive OAuth prompt.
explanations.unfamiliar_site_multiplier: You have never visited this website before, which raises the risk of the observed signs.
